sidebar_empty_hint: Add a local repository to start a thread.
project_dialog_description: Point kkcode at a local repository.
project_setup_hint: Runs in every new worktree with these variables set:
project_trust_hint: Claude Code then loads .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json and CLAUDE.md from this folder. Their hooks run shell commands without asking, and their permission rules can approve tools without an approval card. Leave this off for code you have not reviewed.
thread_composer_placeholder: Ask anything. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
thread_composer_steer_placeholder: Steer the agent… Enter sends while it works.
settings_language_hint: Applies right away. kkcode remembers it on this machine.
thread_empty_hint: Ask {provider} to read, change or explain code in this project.
markdown_diagram_failed: Could not draw this diagram. Showing its source instead.
approval_scope_command: Allow for session also approves this exact command until the session ends:
approval_scope_path: Allow for session also approves {tool} on this path until the session ends:
approval_scope_domain: Allow for session also approves {tool} on any URL at this domain until the session ends:
approval_scope_tool: Allow for session approves every {tool} call, whatever its input, until the session ends.
thread_worktree_hint: Gets its own branch and checkout, prepared by the project's setup script.
panel_removed_hint: The worktree was removed. New runs use the project root.
panel_pr_merged_hint: The pull request is merged. Settle the thread to delete this worktree.
panel_setup_failed: The setup script failed. See the exit code at the end of the log.
panel_changes_root: Only threads that run in a worktree list changes.
panel_changes_removed: The worktree was removed, so there is nothing to compare.
settle_dialog_root: Marks the thread settled. Nothing on disk changes.
settle_dialog_worktree: Marks the thread settled and deletes the worktree folder {path}, including uncommitted changes.
settle_dialog_branch: Deletes branch {branch} only if it is merged into {baseRef}.
settings_models_hint: New threads start with the default model of their agent.
settings_models_unlisted: {provider} did not list its models. Enter a model id instead.
settings_models_failed: Could not list {provider} models: {message}. Enter a model id instead.
settings_keybindings_hint: Select Record, then press the new shortcut. Escape cancels.
settings_keybindings_conflict: Also bound to {commands}. Only one of them will run.
settings_linear_hint: Create a personal API key in Linear under Settings > API. kkcode encrypts it on this machine and never shows it again.
attachment_add_hint: Attach files. You can also paste images or drop files here.
error_persistence: Could not read or write the local database. Try again, and restart kkcode if it keeps failing.
error_project_path_taken: Another project already uses this folder.
error_project_root_invalid: That path is not a folder. Pick an existing folder.
error_pull_request_url_invalid: That is not a GitHub pull request link. Use https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123.
error_linear_request: The Linear request failed. Check the API key in Settings > Integrations.
error_schema: kkcode got data in an unexpected shape. Restart the app, and report a bug if it happens again.
error_ports: Could not inspect or stop the process: {detail}
pr_links_empty: None linked yet. Create one from this branch, or ask an agent to open one.
sidebar_drag_instructions: To reorder, press Space on the handle, move with the arrow keys, then press Space again to drop. Escape cancels.
sidebar_drag_cancel: Reorder cancelled. {title} is back where it was.
sidebar_reorder_failed: Could not save the new order: {message}
delete_dialog_body: Deletes "{title}" with its messages and linked pull requests. This cannot be undone.
delete_dialog_remove_worktree: Also remove its worktree, and its branch if merged
home_description: Run Claude Code and Codex on your local repositories. Each thread can get its own git worktree, prepared by your setup script.
home_hint_ready: New threads start in {project}. Pick another project from the + in the sidebar.
settings_slack_hint: Slack mention automations use this token. Slack only allows message search with an xoxp- user token, so give a Slack app the search:read user scope and paste its user OAuth token. kkcode encrypts it on this machine and never shows it again.
automations_description: Start a thread when a webhook arrives or a new issue or mention shows up. Polling triggers check every minute.
automations_empty_hint: Create one to start threads from webhooks, GitHub or Linear issues, or Slack mentions.
automations_empty_no_project: Add a project first. Every automation starts its threads in a project.
automations_delete_description: Deletes its run history and webhook secret too. Threads it started stay.
automations_bind_loopback_hint: Only programs on this machine can send webhooks.
automations_bind_all_hint: Other devices on your network or tailnet can send webhooks. Each request still needs a valid signature.
automations_dialog_description: Each event renders the prompt template and starts a new thread with it.
automations_trigger_fixed: The trigger type cannot change after creation.
automations_webhook_hint: You get the webhook URL and its signing secret after you create the automation.
automations_repo_hint: owner/name, read with the gh CLI. Only issues opened after you enable the automation start threads.
automations_labels_hint: Optional, comma separated. Issues need every label.
automations_linear_hint: Uses the Linear API key from Integrations. Only issues created after you enable the automation start threads.
automations_slack_hint: Messages that mention this user start threads. Uses the Slack user token from Integrations.
automations_prompt_placeholder: Triage this and propose a fix: {example}
automations_prompt_hint: Placeholders are filled from the event. Missing fields become empty.
automations_worktree_hint: Each run gets its own branch and worktree.
automations_branch_hint: Rendered like the prompt, then made branch-safe. Leave empty to name it after the automation.
automations_enabled_hint: Disabled automations ignore webhooks and stop polling.
automations_webhook_url_hint: POST JSON here, signed with HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body in X-KKCODE-Signature or X-Hub-Signature-256 as sha256=<hex>.
automations_webhook_url_lan_hint: Listening on all interfaces. From another device, use an address it can reach, such as this machine's Tailscale name. Sign the raw body with HMAC-SHA256 in X-KKCODE-Signature or X-Hub-Signature-256.
automations_payload_hint: JSON the prompt template reads, as an event would deliver it. Run now skips duplicate detection.
automations_payload_invalid: The payload is not valid JSON.
automations_secret_description: Configure the sender with this URL and secret. The secret is shown only now.
automations_secret_hint: Store it in the sender now. To get a new one, create a new automation.
project_edit_description: Change the name, folder and setup script of {project}.

match.countPlural=one: Its {count} thread, with its messages and linked pull requests, is deleted. The folder on disk stays. This cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=other: Its {count} threads, with their messages and linked pull requests, are deleted. The folder on disk stays. This cannot be undone.

project_delete_remove_worktrees: Also remove its worktrees, and their branches if merged
pr_gh_missing: Install the GitHub CLI (gh) to see pull request status and create pull requests.
pr_gh_signed_out_after: in a terminal to see pull request status and create pull requests.
settings_github_missing: The GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed.
settings_github_signed_out_before: gh is installed but not signed in. Run
settings_github_hint: kkcode uses your gh login to show pull request status, create pull requests, and poll GitHub issues for automations. Get gh at cli.github.com.
